text: In fifteen ninety, a governor sails back to his colony in America. Everyone is gone.
asr: In 1590, a governor sails back to his colony in America. Everyone is gone.

text: Exhibit one. More than a hundred settlers, including his own granddaughter.
asr: Exhibit one. More than a hundred settlers, including his own granddaughter.

text: Exhibit two. No bodies. No graves.
Exhibit three. One word, carved into a post. Kro-ah-toe-an.
asr: Exhibit three. One word carved into a post. Croatoan.

text: Where did they go? Did they join the Croatoan people? Die at sea? Or move inland?
sub: Where did they go? *A, B or C?*
asr: Where did they go, did they join the Croatone people, die at sea, or move inland?

text: Case still open. What's your verdict?
asr: Case still open. What's your verdict?
